title: Thai Beef Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with spicy Thai beef and crunchy vegetables. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the Thai chili flakes and cook for an additional minute.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the peanut sauce and 1 tablespoon of water.
5. Add the peanut sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
7. Meanwhile, cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
8. Warm the large flour tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
9. Assemble the wrap by spreading a layer of the peanut sauce on the tortilla, followed by the cooked beef, cooked rice, sliced cucumber, carrots, and cilantro.
